WalletTransaction.title: Wallet Transaction
WalletTransaction.description: Represents a single transaction record in a user's wallet or the platform's revenue ledger.

userId.description: The ID of the user (seller/reseller) or a system ID like 'platform_revenue'.

orderId.description: The order that generated this transaction.

amount.description: The monetary value of the transaction. Can be positive or negative.

description.description: A brief description of the transaction.

ErrorLog.title: Error Log
ErrorLog.description: Represents a single logged error from the application for debugging.

code.description: A short, unique code for the error type (e.g., 'API-500').

userId.description: The ID of the user who encountered the error, if any.

ActivityLog.title: Activity Log
ActivityLog.description: Represents a single user or system action for auditing purposes.

userId.description: The ID of the user who performed the action.

details.description: A human-readable summary of the action.

AdCampaign.title: Ad Campaign
AdCampaign.description: Represents an advertising campaign created by a seller for a product.

sellerId.description: The ID of the seller who created the campaign.

productId.description: The ID of the product being advertised.

budget.description: The total budget for the campaign in USD.

BoostRequest.title: BoostRequest
BoostRequest.description: Represents a seller's request to boost a product video on TikTok.

analytics.description: Performance metrics for the boosted video on TikTok.

HomepageSlide.title: Homepage Slide
HomepageSlide.description: Represents a single slide in the homepage promotional carousel.

title.description: The main headline of the slide.

description.description: The subtext or description for the slide.

imageUrl.description: The URL for the background image of the slide.

imageHint.description: A hint for AI image generation tools.

href.description: The destination URL for the slide's call-to-action button.

order.description: The display order of the slide.

AIPosterRequest.title: AI Poster Request
AIPosterRequest.description: Represents a request from a seller for an AI-generated promotional poster.

userId.description: The ID of the user who requested the poster.

productId.description: The ID of the product the poster is for.

prompt.description: The user-provided prompt or style for the poster.

status.description: The current status of the request.

generatedImageUrl.description: The URL of the final generated image, available after approval.

requestedAt.description: Timestamp of when the request was made.

AIFraudAlert.title: AI Fraud Alert
AIFraudAlert.description: Represents a single fraudulent activity or high-risk event flagged by the AI.

type.description: The category of the flagged event.

riskScore.description: A numerical score (0-100) indicating the assessed risk level.

userId.description: The ID of the user associated with the event.

details.description: A human-readable summary of why the event was flagged.

status.description: The current status of the alert.

FraudDetectionSettings.title: FraudDetectionSettings
FraudDetectionSettings.description: Stores the configuration for the AI fraud detection engine.

isEngineActive.description: Globally enables or disables the fraud detection engine.

sensitivity.description: A value (0-100) to adjust how aggressively the model flags transactions.

ContentModerationItem.title: Content Moderation Item
ContentModerationItem.description: Represents a single piece of content flagged for manual review.

contentType.description: The type of content that was flagged.

userId.description: The ID of the user who created the content.

reason.description: The reason why the content was flagged.

content.description: The actual text content that was flagged.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the item was flagged.

ContentModerationSettings.title: Content Moderation Settings
ContentModerationSettings.description: Stores the configuration for the AI content moderation engine.

isSpamActive.description: Enable/disable flagging for spam and promotions.

isPolicyViolationActive.description: Enable/disable flagging for policy violations (e.g., sharing contact info).

HelpArticle.title: Help Article
HelpArticle.description: Represents a single article or Q&A in the help center.

category.description: The category the article belongs to (e.g., 'Getting Started', 'Payments').

audience.description: Specifies who this article is for.

question.description: The question or title of the article.

answer.description: The content or answer of the article.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the article was created.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Represents an administrator with special privileges.

uid.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the admin user.

role.description: Specific role of the admin, e.g., 'SuperAdmin', 'ContentModerator'.

AdminChatMessage.title: Admin Chat Message
AdminChatMessage.description: Represents a single message in the private admin-AI chat.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user profile on the Go Earn platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user profile.

profilePictureUrl.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

bio.description: A short biography of the user.

joinDate.description: Date when the user joined the platform.

userRole.description: The role of the user (e.g., buyer, seller, admin).

status.description: The status of the user account (e.g., active, suspended).

verificationStatus.description: The verification status of the user (e.g., 'pending', 'verified', 'rejected').

following.description: An array of seller IDs that the user is following.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a product listed for sale on the Go Earn platform.

sellerId.description: Reference to UserProfile. The ID of the seller who listed the product. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Product)

description.description: A detailed description of the product.

wasPrice.description: The original price of the product.

shippingCost.description: The shipping cost for the product.

category.description: The category the product belongs to.

uploadDate.description: Date when the product was uploaded.

inCartCount.description: How many users have this item in their cart.

viewCount.description: How many times the product has been viewed.

CartItem.title: CartItem
CartItem.description: Represents a single item in a user's shopping cart.

productId.description: The ID of the product in the cart.

price.description: The price of the product at the time it was added to the cart.

imageUrl.description: The image URL of the product.

addedAt.description: Timestamp when the item was added to the cart.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Represents an order placed by a buyer on the Go Earn platform.

buyerId.description: Reference to UserProfile. The ID of the buyer who placed the order. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Order)

sellerId.description: Reference to UserProfile. The ID of the seller who is fulfilling the order. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Order)

resellerId.description: Reference to UserProfile. The ID of the reseller who facilitated the sale (optional). (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Order)

productId.description: Reference to Product. The ID of the product that was ordered. (Relationship: Product 1:N Order)

orderDate.description: Date when the order was placed.

productPrice.description: Price of the product at the time of order.

totalAmount.description: The total amount of the order (productPrice + shippingCost).

shippingAddress.description: The shipping address for the order.

orderStatus.description: The current status of the order (e.g., pending, shipped, delivered, disputed).

disputeReason.description: A description of the reason for the dispute, if any.

paymentMethod.description: payment method used to place order

trackingNumber.description: The tracking number provided by the shipping carrier.

shippingProvider.description: The company used for shipping (e.g., DHL, G4S).

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description: Represents a payment transaction on the Go Earn platform.

orderId.description: Reference to Order. The ID of the order associated with this payment. (Relationship: Order 1:1 Payment)

paymentDate.description: Date when the payment was made.

paymentMethod.description: The method used for the payment (e.g., M-Pesa, PayPal, Card).

paymentStatus.description: The status of the payment (e.g., pending, completed, failed).

PaymentMethod.title: PaymentMethod
PaymentMethod.description: Represents a user's saved payment method.

id.description: Unique identifier for the payment method.

details.description: Display details for the payment method (e.g., 'Visa **** 4242' or 'user@paypal.com').

isDefault.description: Whether this is the user's default payment method.

providerToken.description: A token from the payment provider (Paystack, PayPal) that references the actual payment instrument. THIS IS NOT THE CARD NUMBER.

PayoutMethod.title: PayoutMethod
PayoutMethod.description: Represents a user's saved method for receiving payouts.

id.description: Unique identifier for the payout method.

Payout.title: Payout
Payout.description: Represents a request from a seller to withdraw their earnings.

id.description: Unique identifier for the payout request.

sellerId.description: The ID of the seller requesting the payout.

amount.description: The amount to be paid out in USD.

payoutMethodId.description: The ID of the PayoutMethod to use.

payoutMethodInfo.description: A snapshot of the payout method details for auditing (e.g., 'PayPal: seller@example.com').

status.description: The current status of the payout request.

requestedAt.description: Timestamp of when the request was made.

processedAt.description: Timestamp of when the payout was processed.

transactionId.description: The transaction ID from the payment provider (e.g., PayPal, Paystack) after completion.

adminNotes.description: Private notes from the admin regarding this payout.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AI-generated description.

productId.description: Reference to Product. The ID of the product the description is for. (Relationship: Product 1:1 AIProductDescription)

generationDate.description: Date when the description was generated.

SellerShop.title: SellerShop
SellerShop.description: Represents a seller's shop on the Go Earn platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the seller's shop.

sellerId.description: Reference to UserProfile. The ID of the seller who owns the shop. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:1 SellerShop)

shopName.description: The name of the seller's shop.

description.description: A description of the seller's shop.

bannerUrl.description: URL of the shop's banner image.

location.description: The location of the seller's shop.

contactWhatsapp.description: contact whatsapp number for the seller

followers.description: Total number of followers for the shop.

isLivePartner.description: Whether the seller has unlocked full live streaming features.

Chat.title: Chat
Chat.description: Represents a chat conversation between two or more users.

id.description: Unique identifier for the chat session.

participantIds.description: An array of user UIDs participating in the chat.

lastMessage.description: The text of the last message sent in the chat.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Represents a single message within a chat.

senderId.description: The UID of the user who sent the message.

messageText.description: The text content of the message.

timestamp.description: Date and time when the message was sent.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Represents a notification for a user.

userId.description: The ID of the user who this notification is for.

message.description: The main content of the notification.

link.description: A URL to navigate to when the notification is clicked.

status.description: The status of the notification ('read' or 'unread').

timestamp.description: Date and time when the notification was created.

id.description: Unique identifier for the live session.

sellerId.description: Reference to UserProfile. The ID of the seller hosting the session.

title.description: The title of the live stream.

status.description: The current status of the session (e.g., upcoming, live, ended).

muxStreamKey.description: The stream key provided by Mux for broadcasting.

muxPlaybackId.description: The playback ID provided by Mux for viewing.

productIds.description: An array of product IDs featured in the session.

startTime.description: The scheduled or actual start time of the session.

endTime.description: The actual end time of the session.

Review.title: Review
Review.description: Represents a customer review for a product.

productId.description: The ID of the product being reviewed.

buyerId.description: The ID of the user who wrote the review.

sellerId.description: The ID of the seller of the product.

comment.description: The text content of the review.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the review was submitted.

ResellerApplication.title: ResellerApplication
ResellerApplication.description: Represents a reseller's application to sell products for a specific seller.

resellerId.description: The ID of the user applying to be a reseller.

sellerId.description: The ID of the seller the user wants to resell for.

applicationDate.description: Timestamp of when the application was submitted.

SupportTicket.title: SupportTicket
SupportTicket.description: Represents a support ticket submitted by a user.

userId.description: The ID of the user who submitted the ticket.

description.description: The user's detailed description of the issue.

status.description: The current status of the ticket.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the ticket was created.

Complaint.title: Complaint
Complaint.description: Represents a formal complaint submitted by a user against another user or a product.

complainantId.description: The ID of the user making the complaint.

targetId.description: The ID of the user or product being complained about.

targetType.description: The type of entity being complained about.

orderId.description: Optional: The ID of the order related to this complaint.

reason.description: A short, categorized reason for the complaint (e.g., 'Spam', 'Harassment', 'Counterfeit').

description.description: The detailed description of the complaint provided by the user.

status.description: The current status of the complaint.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the complaint was submitted.

RecommendationSettings.title: RecommendationSettings
RecommendationSettings.description: Stores the configuration for the AI recommendation engine.

isEngineActive.description: Globally enables or disables the recommendation engine.

model.description: The active AI model for recommendations.

retrainingSchedule.description: How often the model retrains on new data.

newnessWeight.description: A value (0-100) to balance showing new vs. popular items.

serendipityWeight.description: A value (0-100) to balance personalization vs. discovery.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore data structure is designed to support Go Earn's core features, including user profiles, product listings, orders, and payments. It prioritizes authorization independence and efficient data retrieval while maintaining security.  Each user has a dedicated profile document within the `userProfiles` collection. Products are stored in a `products` collection, and each product document includes the `sellerId` for easy association with the seller's profile. Orders are stored in the `orders` collection, and each order document includes `buyerId`, `sellerId`, and `productId` for relationship mapping. Payments are stored in the `payments` collection, linked to the `orderId`. AI-generated descriptions are linked to the products via the `aiProductDescriptions` collection. Categories are managed in a `categories` collection, and seller shops are linked to user profiles via the `sellerShops` collection. Chat messages are now structured in a scalable way, with a top-level `chats` collection containing metadata for each conversation, and a subcollection `messages` within each chat document to hold the actual messages. A new top-level `notifications` collection has been added to serve as a central mailbox for all user notifications, which is critical for the real-time notification system. New singleton documents for AI settings and collections for fraud alerts and content moderation are added to provide centralized management and review capabilities.
